eligibility.geography: validated unchanged boundary regime and election-local seat number; never seat-name-only
eligibility.maori: separate coverage/abstention; no general pooled rule silently applied

allowedTargetInputs: independently published local valid party-vote group counts
observed votes cast and ballot-validity controls if explicitly declared
official post-election candidature for retrospective mapping

as_of_forecast.cutoff: source-pinned official nomination-close timestamp, currently missing
as_of_forecast.missingRequiredInput: abstain or provide explicitly wide bounds
as_of_forecast.forecastClaim: only if every required input passes cutoff audit

ballotAccounting.sourcePopulation: all cast ballots in an electorate, with processed split rows covering valid plus informal party ballots where available
ballotAccounting.massEquation: votesCast = sum(groupMass); for each group, sum(destinationRouteFraction)=1; validCandidateVotes = sum(namedCandidateDestinationVotes)
ballotAccounting.unmatchedMass: Follow targetRouting: release only absent-source-category mass unless an unsupported/ambiguous target destination makes the entire origin row free; never double count, zero-fill or renormalize.
ballotAccounting.publishedSplitCellUnit: rounded percent conditional on party-ballot row; count is unavailable
ballotAccounting.candidateShareDenominator: valid candidate votes, not valid party votes or total split rows
ballotAccounting.zeroPossibleDenominator: undefined candidate share and point abstention
ballotAccounting.jointConstraint: candidate marginal lower/upper bounds are projections of one shared feasible contest ledger, not independently simultaneous endpoints
ballotAccounting.candidateShareBounds: joint candidate-vote / valid-candidate-denominator extrema, never independent endpoint division
ballotAccounting.partyGroupInputConservation: sum of every valid party group, informal party and disallowed/unrepresented remainder equals votes cast; reject or bound inconsistent transformed share vectors, no hidden renormalization

sourcePooling.scope: For each source year 2008/2014/2020, all held general-seat local split matrices; independently of target identity and outcomes. Use only complete uniquely mapped source rows and report all exclusions.
sourcePooling.originWeight: For each canonical party-ballot origin g, source seat s weight n_sg / sum_s n_sg using exact positive party-ballot row counts. Absent/zero-mass origin has no weight; missing positive row or ambiguous mapping is excluded and logged.
sourcePooling.structuralAbsence: Within a complete source row, no candidate of destination party h means p_sgh=[0,0] and the row stays in the pool. A printed 0.00 is a rounded observation, not structural absence.
sourcePooling.rounding: Apply closed conservative [max(0,(x-0.005)/100),min(1,(x+0.005)/100)] to each published two-decimal cell x; retain the cell simplex before aggregating candidate cells by canonical party category. Known independent cells form an unmapped category; category sums are not rounded anew.
sourcePooling.primaryJointSet: Each source row p_sg is in its rounded simplex; q_g=sum_s(n_sg/N_g)*p_sg. The primary target set is this linear image under the transport equality. Marginal endpoints may not be combined independently.
sourcePooling.heterogeneitySensitivity: Separate convex hull of the same eligible source-row rounded simplexes. Marginal [min source feasible endpoint,max source feasible endpoint] is descriptive only and cannot be combined independently; never a calibrated or guaranteed future interval.
sourcePooling.noEligibleSource: Wholly free-route the target origin group and record point abstention.
sourcePooling.destinationSupport: At least one eligible complete source-origin row contains a published candidate cell for the canonical destination party, including printed 0.00; structural zeros alone do not establish support. Known independent source cells are an unmapped category.

targetRouting.personalIdentity: Never enters primary party-category routing; changing only continuation/replacement/unknown labels leaves the feasible set unchanged.
targetRouting.uniquePartyCategory: Route pooled q_g,h to the unique standing candidate of h, independent of personal identity. Distinct person does not inherit outgoing person strength.
targetRouting.absentSourceDestinationInTarget: Release only that coupled category mass q_g,h into a free-routing bucket over every candidate and noncandidate destination; do not release mapped mass or renormalize.
targetRouting.unsupportedOrAmbiguousTargetCandidate: If any standing candidate has no supported source destination category, is independent, or cannot be uniquely mapped to a party category, release each origin row as one free-routing simplex. This supersedes category-specific release for that row and never duplicates its mass.
targetRouting.entrantOrMissingOrigin: A target origin with no positive eligible source rows is wholly free-routed.
targetRouting.candidateOutcome: Winner flags, candidate totals and target split cells cannot affect route applicability.
